signature: SUBROUTINE ZHESWAPR( UPLO, N, A, LDA, I1, I2)

params.name: uplo
N
params.reference: The order of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: A
params.reference:
On entry, the NB diagonal matrix D and the multipliers used to obtain the factor U or L as computed by CSYTRF.

On exit, if $\mathrm{INFO} = 0$, the (symmetric) inverse of the original matrix. If `UPLO = 'U'`, the upper triangular part of the inverse is formed and the part of A below the diagonal is not referenced; if `UPLO = 'L'` the lower triangular part of the inverse is formed and the part of A above the diagonal is not referenced.

params.name: lda
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array A. $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: i1
params.reference: Index of the first row to swap

params.name: i2
params.reference: Index of the second row to swap
